propositions: Plan reviews must track execution vs. planning phase in compiled state, updated only on winning STATUS transitions to in_progress (execution) or open (planning)
Execution-phase reviews enforce a fixed 0.80 priority blocking floor via Pass-3 threshold flooring; planning reviews use original thresholds unmodified
Phase and priority-floor metadata must be serialized in manifest and sidecar v2 JSON in fixed order with strict validation; legacy absent phase/floor defaults to planning
Re-sign must parse recorded review-time phase/floor, refuse incompatible or malformed variants, and build manifest from recorded phase not inferred phase

Pre-LLM/probe generation (phase, priority_floor, own_material, relation_snapshot, ticket_store_revision) must be captured immutable and verified again under write lock before signing; generation changes return terminal unsigned stale
Retry logic retries at most three times only on HEAD instability before retry exhaustion; LLM/provider failure before signing writes no ticket event
